summary: Identified 6 distinct operating sponsors with qualifying closed single‑asset multifamily acquisitions in Tampa between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31 and sized $17.5M–$52.5M. One qualifying SPV (R6695) was consolidated to its evidenced operating parent Dogwood Park 1 Capital (DOGWOOD-SPO-18376). Records excluded fell outside market or window, were brokers/managers, announced bids, portfolio totals, below size, lacked a current qualifying contact, or were published after the cutoff. A prospect CSV with citations has been created.
limitations: All facts are limited to the provided base extracts and source updates; no external corroboration.
Unsigned drafts and post‑cutoff updates were not applied; if later executed, results could change.
Some contacts lack published business emails; nulls are preserved as required.
SPV-to-parent mapping relied on the provided parent_link evidence within records; no external corporate structure validation was performed.
